notes.title: Calculus Cube Update In Progress
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111162/b6533a0e6cfe7e838bd7e1473a51dc4fb90e12f0.jpg[/img]
I am currently working on the Calculus Cube update, a series of kiosks giving an intuitive introduction to key concepts in differential and integral calculus.  Also in this update, we are rolling out a 'talk to the librarian' feature where users can interact using speech with chatGPT through the librarian UI (your own chatGPT key is required).  We are making good progress and expect to release this update sometime in January.
